provenance: RUST-ONLY test fixture (support-other-camera-models Phase 6, revision 2). One catalog sensor entry that tests append to the vendored catalog, to keep covered what no real sensor of catalog 4 exercises any more: a device-tree node named differently from the overlay, a per-sensor numeric option, and an OS requirement of trixie only. Shaped after the former imx662 entry; the facts are invented.

sensor.label: Test camera (fixture)

options.label: Clock frequency
options.description: Frequency of the crystal on the camera board. The overlay default is 24 MHz; check the board vendor for others. The sensor cannot report it, and the driver refuses a rate it does not support.

notes: A FIXTURE, not a real sensor: its device-tree node name (testfam) differs from its overlay name, it has a numeric option besides the imx290's, and it runs on Trixie only.
